case_title: Mariam Fasihuddin & Anr. v. State by Adugodi Police Station & Anr.
statutory_provisions: IPC s.420, s.468, s.471, s.34; Passports Act s.12(b)
trial_court_outcome: Chargesheet filed, case proceeded to trial
neutral_facts: The accused, a married couple, were alleged to have forged the signature of the husband on a passport application for their minor child. The husband, who was living abroad, had allegedly abandoned the wife and child in India. The wife sought to obtain a passport for the child, and the husband later filed a complaint alleging forgery. The investigating agency filed a chargesheet, but the Supreme Court found that the evidence was inconclusive and that the proceedings were an abuse of the process of law. The Court quashed the FIR and all related proceedings, finding that the allegations did not meet the necessary legal standards for the charges brought against the accused.
